rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for rewriting or revising existing text, especially to change its wording or level of detail.

example.english: We need to rewrite this passage to make it easier to understand.
example.traditional: 呢段文要改寫，先至容易明。
example.jyutping: ni1 dyun6 man4 jiu3 goi2 se2 sin1 zi3 jung4 ji6 ming4

rows.note: Use this when the text is written out again without changing its content.

example.english: I wrote the form wrong; can you rewrite it once more without changing anything?
example.traditional: 份表格我寫錯咗，你幫我再寫一次。
example.jyutping: fan6 biu2 gaak3 ngo5 se2 co3 zo2 nei5 bong1 ngo5 zoi3 se2 jat1 ci3
